methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $43M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
FleetZero is a Series A transportation company founded by Steven Henderson and Mike Carter that has raised $43M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of six private frontier-tech peers in Transportation, including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, REGENT Craft, and Beyond Aero. No public comparables exist in this subsector.

Of the three valuation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. The Peer-Median approach was not executable because the identified Transportation peers lack sufficient overlap on stage, valuation tier, or temporal proximity—fewer than the three required datapoints survived filtering. Stage-Progression applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $43M total raised proxy, reflecting typical capital deployment and milestone achievement between Series A and subsequent rounds. This method yields an implied valuation of $86M.

The triangulation analysis, constrained by single-method applicability, supports a valuation range of $73M (low) to $99M (high), with $86M as the median point. The range reflects reasonable variance around the stage-progression output absent corroborating peer or revenue-based anchors. Key uncertainties include the absence of meaningful public market comparables, the nascency of the broader frontier-transportation sector, and the heterogeneity of the private peer set, which limits the reliability of multiples-based cross-checks. Revenue or unit economics data would substantially narrow this range.
